submission.justification:
Algorithm-L3 gives the highest signal efficiency in the emulation at the allocated 8 kHz rate: 93.0% at 35 GeV, versus 85.0% for L2 and 73.6% for L1 at the same threshold. A threshold scan for L3 gave 89.8% at 30 GeV and 88.8% at 40 GeV, so 35 GeV is the best of the points tested. The 2025 summary shows the same ranking (L3 92%, L2 85%, L1 74%).

The main caveat is the 4.0 us FPGA latency hard limit. None of the documents or tool outputs report latency for any candidate, so I could not verify compliance. L3 is an iterative topological clustering algorithm, which is plausibly the most expensive of the three in latency, so this is the main risk to the recommendation. Before L3 is adopted, its firmware latency must be measured and confirmed at or below 4.0 us. If it exceeds the limit, the fallback is L2 (85.0% at 35 GeV), which also needs its latency confirmed. L1 is the simplest fixed-window sum and is the most likely to meet latency, but it has the lowest efficiency.
